name: B014 organization operators and resource ownership

scenarios.name: Organization administrator accesses an organization resource

steps.text: an active organization administrator in organization alpha
the operator requests an alpha device
the request is authorized and attributed to that operator
an operator with <membership_status> membership in organization alpha
the operator requests an alpha message
organization access is <access_result>
an active alpha operator requests a resource in <resource_organization>
the organization-scoped resource query runs
the resource result is <resource_result>

scenarios.name: Client and legacy role claims are not authority

steps.text: a user without an organization grant supplies <client_claims> claims
the legacy user role is ADMIN
the user requests organization data
the request is denied for <client_claims> claims

scenarios.name: A contact remains separate from an application user

steps.text: a contact shares identity text with an application user
the contact is created or changed
no login allowlist membership or grant changes

scenarios.name: Inactive membership invalidates an existing session

steps.text: an operator session contains a stale role claim
membership becomes <membership_status>
the next organization request is denied and history remains attributed
an alpha gateway key attempts <gateway_operation>
gateway scope and organization are evaluated
the gateway operation is <access_result>
administrator safety state <administrator_state>
an administrator demotion is attempted
the demotion is <change_result> with a secret-safe audit event
a development gateway key and message history exist
the records migrate to organization alpha
identifiers and key hashes remain stable within alpha

scenarios.name: First organization migration is idempotent and safe

steps.text: migration state <migration_state>
the first organization migration runs
migration reports <migration_result> without secrets
an authenticated operator with limited organization capabilities
the operator opens the dashboard
only capability-authorized navigation is visible

scenarios.name: No membership shows no organization access

steps.text: an approved user without active organization membership
the user opens the dashboard
the no organization access state exposes only refresh and logout

scenarios.name: Administrator manages an operator by exact email

steps.text: an organization administrator opens Operator Access
the administrator adds an approved exact email with a reason
server-confirmed operator state is displayed

scenarios.name: Access revocation clears a rendered dashboard

steps.text: an operator has rendered organization data
another administrator revokes that membership
the next request clears cached data and privileged navigation
an operator is sender only for group alpha
the sender opens the assigned group
minimum audience data is visible and roster controls are hidden
an administrator adds an approved operator by normalized email
no role assignment accompanies the membership
the dashboard shows No permissions assigned
